newsitem.title: GERMANY: EU oilseeds crush seen falling in 2nd quarter 1997.
newsitem.headline: EU oilseeds crush seen falling in 2nd quarter 1997.

text.p: The European Union oilseeds crush in the second quarter of 1997 may fall to 6.32 million tonnes from 7.45 million tonnes in the first quarter and versus 6.56 million in April-June 1996, the Oil World newsletter said.
The independent publication said out of the total, soybeans should account for 3.47 million (3.41 million last year), rapeseed for 1.52 million (1.83) and sunseed 1.34 (1.32).
It cited declining old crop rapeseed supplies which the other two commodities could not fully offset.
Russia and Ukraine were no longer able to export old crop sunseed after a dramatic increase in sales to the EU.
In the 1996 calendar year the EU-15 imported 1.78 million tonnes of Russian and Ukrainean sunseed, 1.40 million tonnes more than in 1995.
